proposal.value: Qualify Inspect as external evaluator and ALFWorld as a possible text environment; evaluate HSWM as one system.

limit.value: A model-based score alone is not independent environment success. No benchmark was run by the prior research answer.

remaining.value: Freeze evaluator, outcomes, model and budgets, and verify the whole-system bridge and actual generation settings before comparison.

proposal.value: Qualify OpenHands as a replaceable proposal executor; use DGM ideas for candidate lineage, not automatic promotion.

limit.value: Agent orchestration does not establish HSWM recursive cognition. No candidate was shown to satisfy all HSWM composition contracts.

remaining.value: Check typed deltas, stale read sets, independent evaluation, exceptions and shared budgets before two-cell behavioral comparisons.

proposal.value: Reuse DoWhy for identification, estimation and refutation; start with a fixed sample protocol.

limit.value: An analysis package does not supply treatment assignment, state restoration or causal identifiability. Sequential confidence tools have separate assumptions.

remaining.value: Validate null and known-effect fixtures, paired assignment, missing outcomes, restored state and cache controls before efficacy estimation.

title.value: Hyperon comparator and persistent n-ary storage

proposal.value: Qualify Classic AtomSpace plus RocksStorageNode as a storage adapter candidate; retain Hyperon/MeTTa as mandatory architecture comparator.

limit.value: Classic AtomSpace storage is not automatically a Hyperon capability. RocksDB use alone does not establish atomic durable HSWM revisions; exact missing source pins remain unqualified.

remaining.value: Test repeated role occurrences, immutable branches, read-set conflicts and old-or-new revision recovery at exact component commits.

proposal.value: Consider GEPA as a bounded revision proposal/search engine with HSWM-owned evaluation and admission.

limit.value: DSPy GEPA and independent GEPA are not independent algorithms. Optimizer score improvement is not canonical outcome-bound learning.

remaining.value: Separate development, selection and sealed evaluation; compare frozen, prompt-only and typed-revision candidates at declared total budgets.

title.value: Durable TypeScript execution and uncertain delivery

proposal.value: Consider DBOS only if existing Effect execution lacks required recovery; reuse workflow infrastructure.

limit.value: Disabling retries alone does not guarantee at-most-once external delivery. The proposed send right and receipt reconciliation were not tested.

remaining.value: Inject crashes around durable send-right acquisition, external acceptance and receipt recording; preserve UNKNOWN without automatic replay.

proposal.value: Reuse the Neo4j driver and explicit relation/role occurrences; use RDF for exchange and SHACL validation, TypeDB as a role-relation comparator.

limit.value: Flat pair edges can lose roles and repeated participants. SHACL validates declared structure, not permission, concurrency or truth.

remaining.value: Round-trip repeated participants, ordered roles, exact revisions and large integers; verify fresh reads with backend-specific fences.

proposal.value: Qualify a single-call AI SDK or existing Effect adapter for local typed inputs and outputs.

limit.value: Schema-conforming output does not establish semantic correctness. Reported, estimated and unknown usage/model identity must remain distinct.

remaining.value: Compare existing adapter first on malformed JSON, missing usage, timeout, context overflow and no hidden retry; then run bounded live inference.

proposal.value: Reuse fast-check for contract exploration and in-toto/SLSA for artifact integrity where those capabilities are needed.

limit.value: Signed evidence does not prove its content true. Mock contract checks do not establish HSWM efficacy; no new package is adopted here.

remaining.value: Test six declared fault classes, bounded generated traces, uncertain delivery and fresh restored reads before a bounded model trial.

title.value: Temporal memory as a derived query projection

proposal.value: Consider Graphiti for isolated retrieval over existing Neo4j; Hindsight is a separate alternative.

limit.value: Temporal retrieval is neither canonical state nor exact restore. Re-extraction or re-embedding is not a byte-preserving restoration.

remaining.value: Test valid-time/known-time queries, late corrections, role occurrences and restoration without LLM extraction.

proposal.value: Keep the existing HSWM/Effect core and add one missing capability at a time; evaluate with Inspect and common tracing.

limit.value: This is a conditional design synthesis, not evidence that AI SDK, DBOS, Graphiti or another service is installed or necessary.

remaining.value: First inspect the existing pinned runtime; exercise one model, one local transition and one revision before introducing infrastructure.

proposal.value: Consider Effect/OpenTelemetry with MLflow; Phoenix remains an alternative rather than an assumed heavier system.

limit.value: Trace collection is a derived observation surface, not canonical state or causal credit. Operational cost was not measured.

remaining.value: Verify exact trace/artifact linkage, missing fields and private-data handling using existing storage before deploying a new service.
